name: Cybersecurity Complaint Triage
shortDescription: A hackathon concept exploring prioritisation of cybersecurity complaints and identification of potentially low-quality reports.
overview: The concept focused on organising incoming cybersecurity complaints so teams could identify reports that may need urgent attention and separate them from potentially irrelevant or low-priority submissions. This is a concept developed during the IBM Bob Hackathon, not a deployed cybersecurity product.
objectives: Explore how incoming complaints could be prioritised.
Consider how potentially fake, duplicate, or low-importance reports might be flagged.
Improve organisation of reports for human review.
features: Potential low-quality report flagging for human review
challenges: A triage system must avoid incorrectly dismissing genuine, high-risk reports.
Automated priority scores would need clear criteria and human review.
learnings: Turning a broad problem statement into a focused concept.
Considering false positives and risks of automated prioritisation.
results: Concept developed during the IBM Bob Hackathon. No deployment or measured performance is claimed.
